$comment: Admin/public procedures that call a server/ read which FABRICATES a value on a dead database handle, with no dead-handle guard in the procedure body. Generated by scripts/lib/fabricatedAdminReadScan.mjs. THIS IS A RATCHET, NOT AN ALLOWLIST: a NEW pair fails CI; removing one is always fine. It is deliberately not an allowlist-with-reasons, because writing 64 generic reasons is the laundering this repo already has a name for. 2026-09-10 - THE TOTAL GREW 30 -> 76, then 76 -> 75 as the first newly-visible pair was fixed BECAUSE THE SUBJECT WIDENED, NOT BECAUSE THE CODE REGRESSED. The scanner used to read exactly one file, server/db.ts, so the ratchet was an instrument narrower than its own class. Widening it to every tracked non-test file under server/ added 46 pairs that had always existed and were never measured; ZERO previously-recorded pairs were lost, which is the proof this is purely additive. One of the newly visible helpers, getDynamicArticleBySlug, was actively serving Soft 404s to Google. HIGHEST SEVERITY IN THE NEW SET WAS portal.ts::verifyCode -> checkBruteForce, which returned { allowed: true } on a dead handle so the OTP limiter FAILED OPEN, unbounded and unlogged, on a public endpoint. FIXED: it now falls back to an in-process counter enforcing the same 5-in-15min rule and logs every fall-back, so an outage degrades the counter durability without removing the limit. That is the 76 -> 75. Fix either layer - a guard at the router (ROS-083 shape, either getDb() or getDbTyped()) or an available:false helper - and regenerate with: node scripts/update-fabricated-read-baseline.mjs 2026-09-10 later: 73 -> 64 as the last NINE public-tier pairs were guarded (coupons.active, qa.published, pricing.allServices, pricing.estimate, inspection.byToken, inspection.recordView, loyalty.rewards, gallery.list, technicians.list). ZERO public pairs remain; everything still listed is adminProcedure or protectedProcedure. 2026-09-10 FINAL: 64 -> 0. The remaining 64 were converted to db-prefixed procedure builders (dbAdminProcedure / dbProtectedProcedure / dbPublicProcedure in server/_core/trpc.ts), which compose a dead-handle guard onto the same auth tier. The list is now EMPTY and must stay empty: any new (procedure, helper) pair fails CI. The scanner still recognises db-prefixed declarations as procedures precisely so a guarded one is skipped for the RIGHT reason rather than vanishing from the scan - invisible and fixed are the same number otherwise.
